# Basketball shot model validation results - 2D assumed straight-on dataset

> Historical snapshot from before the NBA geometry/ball-parameter alignment.
> Its per-shot predictions and metrics have not been rerun for the current
> physics constants; the input data is assumption-generated, not empirical.

- Input: `data_validation/valid_data_2D.csv` (300 records).
- Validation implementation: `validation.py` calling the existing `simulate_shot()` model; model constants were not tuned.
- Velocity construction: each raw row supplies `Shot_Speed_m_s` and `Release_Angle_deg`; the converter resolves `v0x = speed * cos(angle)` and `v0y = speed * sin(angle)`, with `release_z = v0z = 0`.
- Data caveat: this remains a straight-on approximation. The source measurement axes and release-angle semantics are unverified; source outcomes were not used to select or tune the conversion.

## Executive result

The model predicted **21 made** and **279 miss**. It agreed with 153/300 labels (**51.00%**, Wilson 95% CI **[45.37%, 56.61%]**). The prior vacuum-derived 51-degree input construction agreed with 154/300 (51.33%); the source-speed/angle construction yields 153/300 (51.00%), so it does not improve this outcome-labelled comparison. Neither result is an empirical model-performance estimate.

## Validation checks

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Required nine-column schema; 300 records | PASS |
| Unique shot IDs | PASS (1-300) |
| Physical fields finite and outcomes accepted | PASS |
| Simulation parameter errors | 0 |
| `Shot_Speed_m_s` and `Release_Angle_deg` present on every source row | PASS |
| Outcome counts | 148 made / 152 miss |

## Binary metrics

| Metric | Result |
|---|---:|
| Agreement / accuracy | 153/300 = 51.00% |
| Wilson 95% CI | [45.37%, 56.61%] |
| Disagreement | 49.00% |
| Precision (made) | 52.38% |
| Recall / sensitivity (made) | 7.43% |
| Specificity | 93.42% |
| F1 (made) | 0.130 |
| Matthews correlation coefficient | 0.017 |
| Cohen's kappa | 0.009 |
| Chance agreement | 50.57% |
| No-information rate | 50.67% |
